entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return an item. Order number 788-1B4-99C2.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up your order... I see you purchased the XT-Pro Mountain Bike shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
Look, I don't have time for a long story. They're just not right. Can I return them for a refund, yes or no?
I understand you're looking for a quick answer. Is it a technical fault with the shoes, or more of a preference issue? For example, with the fit or the cleats system?
They gave me terrible blisters after one ride. The fit is all wrong. I just want my money back. I don't want to troubleshoot.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes caused blisters; that's definitely not the experience we aim for. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now. I see the delivery was 28 days ago.
So? Can I return them or not?
Yes, you can. These shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. I can process this return for a full refund for you immediately.
Finally. Okay, what do I do?

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just box up the shoes and drop them off, and your refund will be processed as soon as we receive them.
Okay. Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
